sections.title: Fill in the blanks and write the correct answers.

questions.q: ________ method of cake making is used when we want a quick preparation.
Jam tarts are made from ________ paste.
Macaroons have a ________ texture.
Macaroons are made of almond, sugar and ________.

Creaming method involves creaming of fat with ________.
Biscuits made from egg white mixtures are ________ in texture.
Too much handling of short crust dough results in the fat becoming ________.

sections.title: State whether the following statements are True or False.

questions.q: Pastry dough should be kneaded well to get crisp biscuits.
questions.answer: False. It should be handled as little as possible.

questions.q: A cold area is more suitable for making biscuits.
questions.answer: True. Ingredients and the working area should be cool so that the fat does not melt.

questions.q: Chilling the dough before rolling results in a better texture.
questions.answer: True. The butter becomes firm and the gluten relaxes.

questions.q: Warm water is used for binding the ingredients of short crust dough.
questions.answer: False. Ice cold water is used.

questions.q: Presence of fat on egg whites hinders rising while whisking.
questions.answer: True. Egg yolk contains fat which prevents proper rising of egg white.

questions.q: 'Knock back' is a process during biscuit preparation.
questions.answer: False. Knocking back is a process in bread making.

questions.q: Whisked egg dough biscuits have a domed surface.
questions.answer: True. Entrapped air expands while baking.

questions.q: Nuts used in egg white biscuits are generally ground finely.

sections.title: Answer the following questions (five points each).

questions.q: Mention any five points to remember while preparing short crust (pastry) dough for biscuits.
questions.answer: (i) Keep the ingredients cool and work in a cool area. (ii) Handle the dough as little as possible. (iii) Use ice cold water for binding and do not add too much. (iv) Do not knead; too much handling makes the fat oily and the biscuits rough. (v) Chill the dough before rolling so that the butter becomes firm and the gluten relaxes.

questions.q: Describe the preparation of biscuits by the creaming method.
questions.answer: (i) Cream fat and sugar until the mixture is light and fluffy, since air bubbles are forced into the batter. (ii) Add egg and beat again. (iii) Sieve flour and baking powder and mix in gently, a little at a time, without kneading. (iv) Roll, cut with biscuit cutters and place on a greased tray. (v) Bake at about 160 C for 10-12 minutes and cool on a cooling rack.

questions.q: Name the five types of biscuits according to the method of preparation and explain any one.
questions.answer: (i) Biscuits made from pastry dough, (ii) creamed dough, (iii) egg white mixture, (iv) whisked egg dough and (v) doughs rich in honey and other sugar syrups. Macaroons are made from an egg white mixture: egg whites are whisked, sugar and finely ground nuts are folded in, piped and baked, giving a light, chewy texture.
